subject.title: embedded_run completes with empty final payload → reply silently dropped (lane goes dark, no auto-heal)

question: Should delivery-requested isolated cron embedded runs with no final payload fail closed as cron errors by default when they were not explicit silent replies and were not already delivered by the message tool?
rationale: The issue is a real silent-delivery bug, but the available fix changes terminal status semantics for existing empty completions and overlaps with a separate parser-side repair.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cron error
options.body: Proceed with the cron-level guard after real behavior proof confirms empty completions surface an observable error and silent/source-delivery exemptions remain intact.

options.title: Require retry or supervisor signal
options.body: Ask for a different implementation that emits a supervisor-handled signal or retry path instead of making the cron run itself fail closed.

options.title: Defer to parser-only repair
options.body: Close or pause the cron-level branch only if maintainers decide genuine empty completions do not need a runner/supervisor guard beyond the parser fix.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cron error
recommendation.body: Proceed with the cron-level guard after real behavior proof confirms empty completions surface an observable error and silent/source-delivery exemptions remain intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans cron delivery compatibility and terminal-state semantics, and steipete is the strongest recent history signal on the isolated cron runner boundary.
